strings.name: Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
strings.role: President of the UAE · Ruler of Abu Dhabi
strings.summary: Military-trained Mohamed bin Zayed served as chief of staff and Abu Dhabi crown prince before becoming UAE president and Abu Dhabi ruler in 2022. He has long shaped defence, investment, economic diversification and regional diplomacy, agreeing to normalize relations with Israel in 2020. A UN investigation reported grounds to believe that one network involving individuals and entities in the UAE and other countries supported Sudan’s RSF; the UAE denies military support.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Long involved in UAE governance, he has broad influence in energy transition, international investment and Middle Eastern security diplomacy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Al Ain, then Trucial States, now UAE.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Long-term governance
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from military and crown-prince duties to the presidency, shaping defence, investment and diversification.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h2.title: Normalization with Israel
strings.highlights.h2.text: Agreed with US and Israeli leaders on normalization in 2020, changing regional diplomacy.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Sudan support controversy
strings.timeline.t1.text: UN investigators reported grounds to believe that one network involving people and entities in the UAE and other countries supported the RSF; the UAE denied military support.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Elected UAE president
strings.timeline.t2.text: Federal Supreme Council elected him; also succeeded as Abu Dhabi ruler that month.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Agrees to normalization
strings.timeline.t3.text: Agreed to full UAE–Israel normalization following talks with Trump and Netanyahu.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Deputy supreme commander
strings.timeline.t4.text: Assumed the armed-forces role after chief-of-staff service.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Abu Dhabi crown prince
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became crown prince after Khalifa’s succession and chaired the Executive Council.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Armed-forces chief of staff
strings.timeline.t7.title: Sandhurst training
strings.timeline.t7.text: Graduated from the British military academy before military and state duties.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Al Ain
strings.timeline.t8.text: Zayed’s son, grew up amid social transformation surrounding the UAE’s formation.
